_what: How the live-words stream survives a dropped connection and which codec row it speaks (tools/listen-for-a-while/show/live-audio-stream.ts). `resend`: the audio kept for replay, the overlap replayed before the last confirmed turn, and how many reconnects are tried. `duplicates`: how many recent lines are remembered so a replayed stretch is not shown twice. `codecs` are rows best first: the first row that is enabled and whose needs hold is spoken; fec_extra_percent is the extra loss protection a row asks for (a row, not a code branch); `layers` names extra layers on top of the base codec; `last_rung_only` rows are used only on the last step of the adaptation ladder. Turning a row on is flipping `enabled`; the route takes 16-bit sound only today, so the others are off.
